text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring). Facing Tamamo Cross, who fights for her impoverished family, the answer found was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So, what's the verdict, you two?
Did you find a reason to surpass me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well... nothing in particular comes to mind...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so. A reason ain't somethin'
ya find that easily.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The lucky ones should act like it and just sit quiet, I reckon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Creek, today's mine for the taking!
The star today... is ME!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I'll beat the Trainer pulling the strings from the shadows
to a pulp, too, so they never get back up again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What was that all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't let you.
I won't let you get ahead, Tama-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-You...
I've never seen Creek like this before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, tryin' to act tough won't do ya any good. Races
ain't somethin' you can win on fighting spirit alone!
Super Creek had a look of terrifying determination on her face.
